svg.title: All seven, side by side
svg.desc: Four stages happen before a transaction exists and leak intent: who you considered dealing with, what you checked, what you asked for, what you settled on, what you rejected. Three involve the chain. Read the right-hand column first — it is the one that decides whether a comparison is honest.
